Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' consumable can be cooked by using all fine material ingredients or may be found from chests where it can replace a normal drop with a fixed rate of 1/100

Primary Recipe Output

Make a sweet carrot pie

You grate carrots, combine them with honey, eggs, and potatoes, then pour the mixture into a prepared pie crust. After baking, you let the pie cool before serving.

A delightful blend of sweet carrots, creamy custard, and flaky crust. Perfect for dessert or a special occasion.
